# Horizon Pulse

> Pay-per-call crypto market APIs for AI agents, monetized with x402 v2 on Base (USDC).

Live base URL (canonical): https://horizonpulse.dev
Backup (Vercel): https://horizon-pulse-seven.vercel.app

## Payment (x402 v2)

- Unpaid `GET` → HTTP 402 with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (x402 v2)
- Network: Base mainnet CAIP-2 `eip155:8453`
- Asset: Base USDC `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`
- payTo: `0x5b32c973596078a967562ca652761404f19be0e9`
- Facilitator: Coinbase CDP `https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402`
- Retry the same `GET` with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (v2). Optional: `OPTIONS` returns discovery + `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` without charging.
- Catalog frozen: exactly six live paid routes below. No other paid endpoints.

## Live paid routes

| Method | Path | Price (USDC) | Atomic (6 decimals) | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | /api/pulse | $0.005 | 5000 | BTC/ETH/SOL spot + momentum (CoinGecko) |
| GET | /api/signals | $0.015 | 15000 | RSI/MACD/Bollinger + OKX funding |
| GET | /api/yield | $0.02 | 20000 | DefiLlama yields (TVL ≥ $10M) |
| GET | /api/portfolio?address=0x… | $0.04 | 40000 | Base + Ethereum balances, risk, rebalance suggestions |
| GET | /api/gas | $0.01 | 10000 | Base + Ethereum fee snapshot + timingHint |
| GET | /api/funding | $0.01 | 10000 | OKX BTC/ETH/SOL perpetual funding + crowding hint |

## Free (not paid)

- GET `/` — landing (six routes + agent how-to)
- GET `/status` — live USDC `balanceOf` on payTo + catalog
- GET `/llms.txt` — this file
- GET `/openapi.json` — OpenAPI snippet for the six paid routes

## Agent how-to (short)

1. Call routes on `https://horizonpulse.dev` (canonical; vercel.app is backup).
2. `GET` a paid route with no payment → 402 + `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`.
3. Confirm network `eip155:8453`, Base USDC, atomic `amount`, and `payTo`.
4. Sign and retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
5. On success, response body is live JSON for that route.

## Honesty

- Real upstream data only (CoinGecko, OKX, DefiLlama, public RPCs). No stubbed prices.
- Do not invent routes, prices, or Bazaar index status.
